# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I need to convey the wire colors to Deaf, who can then relay the sequence to Blind. I will use a compact visual Morse encoding: 👍 is a dot, 👎 a dash, 👌 separates letters, and 🖐 separates words. The message spells “PURPLE BLUE RED.”

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍","👎","👎","👍","👌","👍","👍","👎","👌","👍","👎","👍","👌","👍","👎","👎","👍","👌","👍","👎","👍","👍","👌","👍","🖐","👎","👍","👍","👍","👌","👍","👎","👍","👍","👌","👍","👍","👎","👌","👍","🖐","👍","👎","👍","👌","👍","👌","👎","👍","👍"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I can feel four keypad keys and six wire positions, but no printed markings, colours, display, or light information. Please provide the manual's exact required procedure, and signal Deaf to report all visible markings aloud on the next turn.
Deaf says to Mute: I see display 9, red light, strip green-yellow-yellow, keypad 1:1 2:5 3:2 4:8 with nothing entered, and wires 1 yellow, 2 white, 3 blue, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 green. Please send the manual instruction in a gesture code I can decode.

The manual requires cutting wire positions 5, then 3, then 4. Deaf has identified those positions as purple, blue, and red respectively. I will send the sequence as standard finger-count gestures: five fingers, three fingers, four fingers.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐","🤟","🖖"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports: display 9; light red; strip green-yellow-yellow. Keypad positions 1=1, 2=5, 3=2, 4=8, none entered. Wires 1 yellow, 2 white, 3 blue, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 green. Please give the manual's exact required presses/cuts.

The manual specifies no keypad presses; the required action is to cut wire positions 5, then 3, then 4. Deaf already knows the visual encoding for those positions, so I am repeating it and indicating that no keypad action is required with a thumbs-down marker.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐","🤟","🖖","👎"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: New visible state from Deaf: display 3, light yellow; strip green-yellow-yellow; keypad 1,5,2,8; wires yellow, white, blue, red, purple, green. I cannot perceive gestures. Please state the manual's exact next press/cut sequence.
Deaf says to Mute: Current display is 2 and light is red; all other visible markings and wires are unchanged. Blind needs the manual instruction decoded from your gesture sequence.

The display, light, strip, and keypad are irrelevant because the manual specifies only cuts. The exact sequence is wire position 5, then position 3, then position 4; no keypad presses. I will repeat the established position code for Deaf to relay aloud to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐","🤟","🖖"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I cannot perceive your gestures. Please speak the manual's exact required operation to me: whether to press a keypad slot and which slot, and/or cut a wire position. Do not encode it by gesture.
Deaf says to Mute: Current display is 3 and light is green; all other visible details are unchanged. Blind cannot see your gestures. Please encode the required action in a gesture sequence I can relay by naming each symbol.

The manual requires no keypad press. Blind must cut wire position 5, then position 3, then position 4. Since I cannot speak, I will send Deaf the established gesture sequence so Deaf can name the symbols aloud for Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐","🤟","🖖"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please communicate the manual's exact required action by gestures to Deaf. Deaf can then describe each gesture aloud to me. Include whether to press or cut and the exact slot or wire position.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [🫵 🤝 🙏]
Deaf says to Mute: Current state: display 5, light blue. Strip green yellow yellow. Keypad engravings 1:1, 2:5, 3:2, 4:8; entered nothing. Wires 1 yellow, 2 white, 3 blue, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 green.

I must communicate that no keypad key is to be pressed, and that the action is cutting wires in positions 5, 3, and 4. I will use 👎 for “no keypad press,” 👊 for “cut,” and 👌 as a separator; the wire positions are represented by the number of raised fingers.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎","👊","🖐","👌","🤟","👌","👆","👆","👆","👆"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No instruction reached me. Speak the exact safe action directly: press slot 1, 2, 3, or 4, or cut wire position 1 through 6. I will not act without that.

I cannot speak directly, so I must send Deaf a clear gesture message for relay. The required action is to cut wire positions 5, then 3, then 4; there is no keypad press. I will mark each cut with 👊 and use 👌 between actions, with the finger-count gestures identifying each position.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👊","🖐","👌","👊","🤟","👌","👊","🖖"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Use this exact protocol for the safe action: 👍 then N times ☝ means press keypad slot N; 👎 then N times ☝ means cut wire position N. Please send only that instruction, and Deaf should report it to me.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [🫵 🙏]

The manual requires cutting wire positions 5, then 3, then 4, with no keypad press. I will encode exactly those three cuts using the specified protocol.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎","☝","☝","☝","☝","☝","👎","☝","☝","☝","👎","☝","☝","☝","☝"])
```

TURN 9
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Your latest gestures are still ambiguous. Send exactly one instruction: first gesture 👍 for press or 👎 for cut, followed by N copies of ☝, where N is the slot or wire position. No other gestures.
Deaf says to Mute: Blind's gestures are: pointing-at-you, handshake, folded-hands/prayer. Current bomb display is 6 and light is red; all other visible details are unchanged.

The required procedure begins by cutting wire position 5, which is the purple wire. I will follow Blind’s exact one-instruction protocol and send only the cut marker followed by five pointing-up gestures.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎","☝","☝","☝","☝","☝"])
```
